description: Source code for the OV2640 camera driver in Zephyr RTOS, including register definitions, configuration, initialization, and control functions.

methods.name: ov2640_write_reg
methods.description: Writes a byte to a specified register over I2C.

methods.name: ov2640_read_reg
methods.description: Reads a byte from a specified register over I2C.

methods.name: ov2640_write_all
methods.description: Writes a sequence of register-value pairs to the device.

methods.name: ov2640_soft_reset
methods.description: Performs a soft reset of the device.

methods.name: ov2640_set_level
methods.description: Sets camera parameters like brightness, contrast, saturation based on level.

methods.name: ov2640_set_brightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness level.

methods.name: ov2640_set_saturation
methods.description: Sets the saturation level.

methods.name: ov2640_set_contrast
methods.description: Sets the contrast level.

methods.name: ov2640_set_output_format
methods.description: Configures the output image format (JPEG or RGB565).

methods.name: ov2640_set_quality
methods.description: Sets the JPEG quality.

methods.name: ov2640_set_colorbar
methods.description: Enables or disables color bar test pattern.

methods.name: ov2640_set_white_bal
methods.description: Enables or disables auto white balance.

methods.name: ov2640_set_gain_ctrl
methods.description: Enables or disables automatic gain control.

methods.name: ov2640_set_exposure_ctrl
methods.description: Enables or disables automatic exposure control.

methods.name: ov2640_set_horizontal_mirror
methods.description: Enables or disables horizontal mirror.

methods.name: ov2640_set_vertical_flip
methods.description: Enables or disables vertical flip.

methods.name: ov2640_set_resolution
methods.description: Sets the camera resolution.

methods.name: ov2640_check_connection
methods.description: Checks if the device is connected and responding.

methods.name: ov2640_set_fmt
methods.description: Configures the video format and resolution.

methods.name: ov2640_get_fmt
methods.description: Retrieves the current video format.

methods.name: ov2640_stream_start
methods.description: Starts video streaming.

methods.name: ov2640_stream_stop
methods.description: Stops video streaming.

methods.name: ov2640_get_caps
methods.description: Retrieves device capabilities.

methods.name: ov2640_set_ctrl
methods.description: Sets various camera controls like flip, white balance, etc.

methods.name: ov2640_init
methods.description: Initializes the device, resets, and configures default settings.
